selection_criteria.big_national_banks: Institutions were screened strictly against active FDIC-insured banks in the FDIC BankFind Suite API (ACTIVE = 1 AND INSFDIC = 1, Q2 2026 Call Report 06/30/2026). Every active institution sits inside the Top 56 largest U.S. banks by total assets ($43.45B to $4.09T; combined $14.84T in assets and $7.46T in domestic deposits). Twelve of the eighteen active institutions are national banks (BKCLASS = N); the remaining six are large state-chartered member/nonmember/savings banks. Small local banks, credit unions, and non-bank fintech wrappers are excluded.
selection_criteria.digital_app: Digital mobile banking apps and security controls are verified directly on each bank's official domain and US App Store listing. Alto by BMO (CERT 16571) is explicitly flagged and excluded from mobile-eligible ladders because Alto operates web-only with no mobile app.
selection_criteria.fdic: Every active institution is confirmed ACTIVE = 1 and INSFDIC = 1 in FDIC BankFind on 2026-10-22. Coverage rules ($250k single, $500k joint, up to $1.25M revocable/POD trust per grantor across 5+ beneficiaries) come directly from FDIC.gov.
selection_criteria.rates: APY values are transcribed strictly from first-party bank disclosures and rate sheets with each bank's effective date. Rates blocked behind interactive ZIP modals or template placeholders without an official first-party rate document are left blank (null) and listed on Flagged for review.
